title: Death Pointer
description: A datapack that when you die shows you where you died.
body:
## Here is how it works:
When you die it shows you where you died using [waypoints](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Commands/waypoint).

![Waypoint](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd8c03353dadeb25882ac8ba24749efb1c18810c.png)

It also makes a pillar using red dust particles.

![Pillar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4de0fbb92c7475c2d168a7b819923e6a640d09ee.png)

The waypoint and the pillar will be deleted when you get close.
